chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: Now that we know how to create HTML pages, let's see some coding in action.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: And HTML element usually consists of a start tag and an end tag with the content inserted in between.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: The HTML element is everything from the start tag to the end tag.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: For example, the HTML P element defines a paragraph.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: So if you want a paragraph on your page, write the P start tag, add content inside and close it with the forward slash P end tag.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: This is now a HTML P element, also known as a paragraph element.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: All HTML documents consist of nested HTML elements.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: Nested elements are elements within elements.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: For instance, these two elements are nested within the body element, which in turn is nested within the HTML element.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: Let's take a closer look at the different elements.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: First, the HTML element defines the HTML document.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: It comes with a start tag and an end tag.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: Inside the HTML element, we have the body element, which defines the document body.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: It comes with a start tag and an end tag.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: The body element contains two other HTML elements.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: The first one defines a heading with the text, my first heading.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: The second one defines a paragraph with the text, my first paragraph.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: Remember to always include the end tag.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: It might work without it, but there's always a chance it will produce unexpected results or errors.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: However, some HTML elements do not have content.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: They're called empty elements and do not have end tags.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: An example of this is the BR element, which is an element with no content.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: It just defines a line break.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: HTML tags are not case sensitive.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: Both lowercase and uppercase works and means the same thing.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: However, it is recommended to use lowercase tags.

chunks.title: Elements
chunks.text: And with that said, we've covered the basics of HTML elements and how to use them.
